questions.passage: Is efficiency everything? Escape the productivity trap once in a while. Think of a slower way to do the same thing —bake your own bread; hand-grind your own coffee beans…do it yourself, and add some spice to your life.
questions.prompt: What change does the closing invitation recommend?
options: Never paying attention to productivity in any area of life.
Replacing all paid work permanently with bread making.
Finding the fastest available method for every everyday activity.
Occasionally choosing a slower hands-on way to add variety to life.
questions.promptZh: 结尾的邀请建议作什么改变？
optionsZh: 生活任何领域都永不考虑生产力。
永久把所有有偿工作换成烤面包。
为每项日常活动寻找最快方法。
偶尔选较慢、亲手做的方式，为生活增添变化。
analyses: A once in a while 限定为偶尔，不是永不考虑。
B bake...hand-grind 是生活例子，不是永久改职业。
C slower way 与一律最快相反。
D 偶尔离开效率优先、用DIY增添 spice 的意思完整。spice 是比喻性的趣味变化，不要求实际给咖啡或面包加某种香料。

questions.passage: He went on to describe the magic novelists wield, remarking how “for the space of an hour he [the novelist] sets free within us all the joys and sorrows in the world, a few of which only we should have to spend years of our actual life in getting to know, and the most intense of which would never be revealed to us.” So, yes, it is possible to lead a psychologically rich life via books.
questions.prompt: What conclusion does the author draw from the novelist’s power described here?
options: Books can make a psychologically rich life possible through access to many emotions.
Only direct travel can reveal emotions to a reader.
Every reader is guaranteed to feel all emotions within exactly one hour.
Reading removes the need for any firsthand experience in every life.
questions.promptZh: 作者从这里描述的小说家力量得出什么结论？
optionsZh: 书能让人接触多种情绪，从而使心理丰富人生成为可能。
只有亲自旅行能让读者认识情绪。
每位读者都保证在恰好一小时内体验全部情绪。
阅读使每个人都不再需要任何亲身体验。
analyses: A 最后 possible...via books 明示可能性，前面的 joys and sorrows 提供文学说明。
B 小说家的作用就是让人接触原本需要多年或不会亲历的情绪，不限旅行。
C 文学引语的 hour 不是给所有人的实测时限与保证。
D possible via books 不是阅读排除或替代全部直接体验。应区分作者结论与作为支持例子的 Proust 文学引述。

evidence.quote: it is possible to lead a psychologically rich life via books.

vocabulary.context: 形容小说家运用文字使读者感受情绪的文学力量，不是挥舞实物
vocabulary.example: The writer wields language with unusual precision.

questions.translation: 他接着描述小说家施展的魔力，说“在一个小时里，他［小说家］在我们内心释放世间全部喜悦与悲伤；其中仅仅少数，就需我们花真实人生中的多年才能认识，而最强烈的一些原本永远不会向我们显露”。因此，确实有可能通过书籍过一种心理丰富的人生。

questions.passage: To me, Kazuo Ishiguro’s The Remains of the Day is not just an engrossing novel about Mr. Stevens, a British butler who works for the nobleman Lord Darlington until the end of World War II; it is also about moral dilemmas and the meaning of life. In the novel, Mr. Stevens (played by Anthony Hopkins in the film version) served Lord Darlington as best as he could. At the peak of his career, he managed a staff of twenty-eight as Lord Darlington hosted many important meetings during World War II.
questions.prompt: What does the author see in The Remains of the Day beyond an engaging story?
options: A practical manual for managing a household.
An exploration of moral dilemmas and life’s meaning.
A statistical history of every British butler.
A film review concerned only with the actors.
questions.promptZh: 作者认为 The Remains of the Day 除了引人入胜的故事，还探讨什么？
optionsZh: 管理家务的实用手册。
道德困境与人生意义。
所有英国管家的统计史。
只关注演员的影评。
analyses: A 管家职责是故事背景，不是本段所说的额外主题。
B not just...also about moral dilemmas and the meaning of life 直接定位主题。
C in the novel 限定虚构人物，非全体管家统计。
D 电影演员是括号补充，不能覆盖小说主题。

evidence.quote: it is also about moral dilemmas and the meaning of life.

vocabulary.context: 形容小说吸引注意力，与它还有道德主题并不矛盾
vocabulary.example: The engrossing story kept her reading until midnight.

questions.translation: 对我而言，Kazuo Ishiguro 的 The Remains of the Day 不仅是一部引人入胜的小说，讲述英国管家 Stevens 为贵族 Darlington 服务直到二战结束，也讨论道德困境与人生意义。小说中，Stevens——电影版由 Anthony Hopkins 饰演——尽力侍奉 Darlington。在事业巅峰，他管理二十八名员工，而 Darlington 在二战期间主持许多重要会议。
